anomalies.observed: PCA9685PW pin 1 (A0) is on net +3.3V, while its address pins A1 (pin 2), A2 (pin 3), A3 (pin 4), A4 (pin 5) and A5 (pin 24) are on GND. Tying A0 high sets the I2C address LSB to 1, giving 0x41 rather than 0x40.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PWM driver as "NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40". With all address-select pins low, the address is 0x40, so A0 should be tied to GND like the other address pins.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The FCC will address the PWM driver at 0x41 instead of 0x40. Firmware using 0x40 gets no acknowledgement, so no servo PWM output is produced and the control surfaces will not respond.
